page.title: Growth
page.subtitle: Your action plan: where you stand, where to go next, and which patterns to lean into or step away from.

whereYouStand.heading: Where you stand
whereYouStand.leadershipMissing: Take the Leadership self-assessment to see your archetype.
whereYouStand.behavioralMissing: Take the Behavioral Core to see your sub-profile.

pathForward.heading: Path forward
pathForward.hint: The natural progression dampens your current primary behavior and amplifies the next one in the ORGANIC Agility sequence.
pathForward.guidance: To grow into {{next}}, do less of {{dampen}} and more of {{amplify}}.
pathForward.peakBody: Strategist is the natural endpoint of the ORGANIC Agility sequence. Lateral growth from here is about Layer 2 (behavioral) and Layer 3 (saboteur) work — not another archetype shift.
pathForward.missing: Take the Leadership self-assessment to see your growth path.

saboteurAntidotes.heading: Your top 3 saboteur antidotes
saboteurAntidotes.hint: These are the patterns most likely to hijack you under stress, and the Sage Powers that counter them.
saboteurAntidotes.missing: Take the Attitude assessment (10 min) to see your saboteurs and their antidotes.

hiddenBlind.heading: Hidden strengths & blind spots
hiddenBlind.hint: Where your peers' view differs from your own self-assessment.
hiddenBlind.hiddenColumnHint: Peers see this in you more than you see it in yourself.
hiddenBlind.blindColumnHint: You rate yourself higher here than your peers do.
hiddenBlind.noneHidden: No hidden strengths surfaced — peer view tracks your own.
hiddenBlind.noneBlind: No blind spots surfaced — peer view tracks your own.
hiddenBlind.missing: Ask peers to rate you on Leadership to unlock this view.

skillsToImprove.heading: Top 3 skills to improve
skillsToImprove.hint: Your lowest self-rated skills — natural candidates for focused practice.
skillsToImprove.atCapBody: All your skills are at the top level (4). Time to focus on what's beyond the skills inventory.
skillsToImprove.missing: Complete the Skills self-assessment to see your growth priorities.
